systemic_follow_up.rationale: The audit found wording improvements for individual bounty descriptions, not a code or template defect requiring a new issue or PR.

observations.title: Publish an evidence redaction fixture pack
replacement_snippets: Deliver a public fixture index for an evidence redaction pack. The public_url must load a stranger-readable index that links every fixture, the expected redacted output, and the command used to verify it.
observations.review_rationale: Workers can verify the same bar faster if the landing page and fixture index expectation is stated before the review gate.

observations.title: Explain Frantic claim verification clearly
replacement_snippets: Write a worker-facing claim verification guide. It must explain how a worker checks claim availability, proves identity requirements without exposing secrets, and confirms receipt state after claim and delivery.
observations.review_rationale: The task is easier to complete when the intended reader and two rerunnable checks are explicit.

observations.title: Audit the runx CLI first-run experience
replacement_snippets: Audit exactly these first-run moments: install command, `runx --version`, `runx --help`, one catalog read/search command, and one failed command. Capture command, output, exit state, and the copy issue for each.
observations.review_rationale: A required command list prevents subjective UX-only reports and preserves the reproducible proof bar.

observations.title: Publish a Frantic delivery artifact linter
replacement_snippets: Deliver a linter package plus PR. The pr_url must contain the linter source and tests; public_url must load runnable usage docs; evidence_json must include at least one passing delivery and one failing delivery with exact linter output.
observations.review_rationale: Putting PR/source/test expectations in the deliverable sentence reduces wrong artifact submissions.

observations.title: Dogfood the Frantic MCP board reader
replacement_snippets: Dogfood the Frantic MCP board reader against the public board surface. Capture the exact board-read call, response summary, redaction policy, and at least two checked fields from the live board response.
observations.review_rationale: Naming the surface and checked fields keeps MCP evidence inspectable without exposing private data.

observations.title: Audit the live Frantic board health
replacement_snippets: Audit live board health across claim slots, funded liability, open/delivered/accepted/paid counts, stale listings, and ledger consistency. For each finding, cite the live endpoint or bounty page and the timestamp observed.
observations.review_rationale: Specific health dimensions make the report objectively reviewable.

observations.title: Audit Frantic bounty copy for worker clarity
replacement_snippets: Audit at least eight live Frantic bounty pages, preferably a contiguous current slice such as #38-#47. If all findings are one-off copy edits, say that directly and use the bounty issue as the follow-up link; only open a separate issue or PR for systemic tooling or template defects.
observations.review_rationale: The replacement removes ambiguity about page count and follow-up obligations while preserving the verification bar.

observations.title: Audit Sourcey docs gaps on a real library
replacement_snippets: Audit a real Sourcey output against one maintained library and classify each gap as source coverage, navigation, example quality, API naming, source mapping, or maintainer usefulness. Include at least one gap that a maintainer could act on.
observations.review_rationale: Named gap categories keep the audit useful and prevent vague docs opinions.

observations.title: Publish Sourcey docs for a second ecosystem
replacement_snippets: Before generation, list the live or accepted Sourcey docs bounties you checked and state the ecosystem already represented. Choose a different ecosystem, record the checked bounty URLs in evidence_json, and explain why the selected library does not collide.
observations.review_rationale: A concrete dedupe step avoids wasted work and makes the second-ecosystem rule checkable.

observations.title: Run a public runx registry install smoke matrix
snippets: runs or inspects harness/published usage path
replacement_snippets: Submit a smoke matrix with columns for package ref, install command, OS, shell, runx version, registry read output, run or harness output, receipt or failure ref, and reviewer rerun command.
observations.review_rationale: A fixed matrix shape gives reviewers enough data to rerun or compare each registry package result.
